cards.ex: I'll run the proposal by my boss before submitting it.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotni topshirishdan oldin, uni boshlig'im bilan maslahatlashaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishdan oldin birovning fikrini so'rash, maslahatlashmoq.

cards.ex: I feel like just a cog in the machine at this huge corporation.
cards.exUz: O'zimni shu katta korporatsiyada oddiy bir vintdek his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Katta tashkilotda unchalik ahamiyatga ega bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: The company hopes increased sales will offset the costs of the new advertising campaign.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sotuvlar o'sishi yangi reklama kampaniyasining xarajatlarini qoplashiga umid qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sarflangan pulni boshqa yo'l bilan qoplash yoki kamaytirish.

cards.ex: After years in management, I decided to teach – it's a nice change of pace.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik menejmentdan so'ng, o'qituvchilik qilishga qaror qildim - bu yaxshi ish ritmini o'zgartirish.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan boshqacha, qiziqarli narsa qilish.

cards.ex: The manager had to take the heat for the team's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Menejer jamoaning yomon ishlashi uchun javobgarlikni olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki muammo uchun tanqidni yoki jazoni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The contract was awarded after what many suspected was a backroom deal.
cards.exUz: Shartnoma ko'pchilik yashirin kelishuv deb gumon qilganidan keyin berildi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq bo'lmagan, shaffof bo'lmagan kelishuv.

cards.ex: Skilled programmers are always in demand and can command a salary at a premium.
cards.exUz: Malakali dasturchilar har doim talabga ega va yuqori narxda maosh olishlari mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan yuqori narxda sotiladigan.

cards.ex: My boss likes to keep tabs on everything I do.
cards.exUz: Boshlig'im men qilayotgan hamma narsani nazorat qilishni yoqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan kuzatib borish, nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: We finished the project down to the wire, just before the deadline.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani muddat tugashidan oldin, oxirgi daqiqalarda tugatdik.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi daqiqalarda, vaqt tugashiga yaqin.

cards.ex: The new contract was a real shot in the arm for the company.
cards.exUz: Yangi shartnoma kompaniya uchun haqiqiy rag'batlantiruvchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishga yoki rivojlanishga turtki beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Now that she's CEO, she's really calling the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Endi u bosh direktor bo'lgani uchun, u bu yerda haqiqatan ham boshqaruvni qo'lga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qarorlar qabul qilish, vaziyatni boshqarish.

cards.ex: She brings a lot of experience to the table, which will be invaluable.
cards.exUz: U ko'p tajribaga ega, bu bebaho bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Guruhga yoki loyihaga foydali qobiliyatlar yoki tajriba olib kelish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by scheduling a meeting.
cards.exUz: Keling, uchrashuv belgilab, ushbu loyihani ishga tushiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, jarayonni ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: I can't help you this week, I have a lot on at the moment.
cards.exUz: Men sizga bu hafta yordam bera olmayman, hozirda ishim ko'p.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda juda ko'p ish yoki mas'uliyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: My job is on the line if I don't meet this deadline.
cards.exUz: Agar men ushbu muddatga erishmasam, ishim xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida bo'lish, yo'qotish xavfi ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The software industry is known for its cut-throat competition.
cards.exUz: Dasturiy ta'minot sanoati shafqatsiz raqobati bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Agressiv va shafqatsiz raqobat.

cards.ex: The factory can churn out thousands of units per day.
cards.exUz: Fabrika kuniga minglab mahsulot ishlab chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tez va ko'p miqdorda ishlab chiqarish.

cards.ex: We're short-staffed today, so expect delays.
cards.exUz: Bugun bizda xodimlar yetishmaydi, shuning uchun kechikishlarni kuting.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli xodimlar bilan ta'minlanmagan, xodimlar soni kam.

cards.ex: The job comes with excellent fringe benefits, including health insurance.
cards.exUz: Ushbu ish sog'liq sug'urtasi kabi ajoyib qo'shimcha imtiyozlar bilan birga keladi.
cards.uzDef: Maoshdan tashqari, xodimga beriladigan qo'shimcha imtiyozlar.

cards.ex: The new promotion is a mixed blessing; it's more money, but also more responsibility.
cards.exUz: Yangi lavozim aralash baraka; bu ko'proq pul, lekin ko'proq mas'uliyat ham.
cards.uzDef: Ham yaxshi, ham yomon tomonlari bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Many small businesses went belly up during the recession.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab kichik bizneslar retsessiya davrida bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biznesning muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi, bankrot bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I've always wanted to be my own boss and start my own company.
cards.exUz: Men har doim o'z xo'jayinim bo'lishni va o'z kompaniyamni ochishni xohlaganman.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga hisobot bermasdan, o'z ishini boshqarish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses, regardless of size.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun, hajmiga qaramay, teng sharoitlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha uchun adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar mavjud bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: I don't want to be a paper pusher my whole life; I want to do something meaningful.
cards.exUz: Men butun umrim davomida qog'ozboz bo'lishni xohlamayman; men mazmunli bir narsa qilishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Zerikarli, muhim bo'lmagan ish bilan shug'ullanadigan odam.

cards.ex: He got the boot for constantly being late to work.
cards.exUz: U ishga doimiy ravishda kechikkani uchun ishdan haydaldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan haydalish, ishdan bo'shatilish.

cards.ex: It's hard to make ends meet on a minimum wage salary.
cards.exUz: Minimal ish haqi bilan ro'zg'orni tebratish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Daromad bilan xarajatlarni qoplay olish, ro'zg'orni o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Everyone knows she wears the trousers in that relationship.
cards.exUz: Hamma biladi, bu munosabatlarda u oilani boshqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Oilada eng muhim qarorlarni qabul qiladigan odam bo'lish.

cards.ex: The promotion is up for grabs, so everyone has a chance.
cards.exUz: Lavozim ega chiqish uchun ochiq, shuning uchun har kimda imkoniyat bor.
cards.uzDef: Hali hech kimga tegishli bo'lmagan va har kim ega chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The hospital is severely understaffed, which puts a strain on the nurses.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona juda kam xodimga ega, bu hamshiralarga og'irlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kerakli miqdordan kam xodimga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: With the company downsizing, many employees feel like they're on the chopping block.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya kichrayayotgani sababli, ko'plab xodimlar o'zlarini ishdan ketish xavfi ostida his qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatilish xavfi ostida bo'lish.
